title: Refresh header targets a script scheme
description: The Refresh header carries a url= target whose scheme is javascript: or vbscript:. The header exists to send the browser to another document, so a script scheme turns a redirect control into an inline script sink: wherever the value is derived from request data, an attacker can place markup that executes in the page origin.
remediation: Build the Refresh target from a fixed allowlist of paths, not from request data, and never emit a script scheme. Prefer an HTTP 3xx redirect, which cannot carry a script scheme, and treat any existing javascript: target in configuration as a defect to remove.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the scheme the header names; it cannot prove the value is attacker-influenced, and some browsers block Refresh navigation to script schemes outright, so impact depends on the client.
